rebuttals.text: Kamala Harris has the deepest resume in the field: DA, Attorney General, Senator, Vice President.
Kamala Harris cast the tie-breaking votes for the biggest laws of the Biden era.
Kamala Harris was the administration's lead voice for reproductive rights.
Kamala Harris is the only Democrat with national campaign infrastructure ready on day one.
Kamala Harris has already been vetted by the harshest spotlight in politics.
